items.title: 28% increase in passports issued by the Italian Consulate in Dubai
items.description: (ANSA) - ROMA, 28 LUG - The Consulate General of Italy in Dubai reports that in the first six months of 2026, it issued 1,340 passports, compared to 1,046 during the same period in 2025. This represents a 28% increase. “This increase,” explains the consulate, “did not occur in spite of the conflict, but rather because of the conflict.” Furthermore, the consular offices remained open throughout March to renew expiring passports and issue first passports to newborns. Read article...

items.title: Italy 'books' SAFE loan of up to €14.9 billion, but EC says deal must be signed ASAP
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, JUL 28 - Deputy Premier and Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani said Tuesday that the government has reserved the right to take a loan from the EU's SAFE (Security Action for Europe) facility of up to 14.9 billion euros to invest in security and defence. Tajani stressed that the loan only has been "reserved" and that the government will decide by the end of the year how much actually to take, if any, as he reported to a joint session of the defence and foreign affairs committees of the Lower House and Senate over the recent NATO summit in Ankara.
